ld.description: Mild by Nature Nature’s Gate Shampoo for Normal Hair Formulated with Herbs to Gently Cleanse and Nourish Normal Hair Featuring Sage, Lavender, and Rosemary With Clean, Natural Ingredients – No Artificial Colors Vegan and Cruelty Free No Nasties – Paraben Free • Gluten Free • Soy Free • Phthalate Free Formulated with Mild Ingredients for the Comfort of the Entire Family We’re excited to share that Nature’s Gate is now a part of the Mild by Nature family of products. You can still expect the same eco-conscious and nature-inspired formulas, just with a new brand and a new family of effective personal care products. Normal hair has a good balance of natural oils, so it’s important to invest in haircare to help retain this balance. Mild by Nature Nature’s Gate Shampoo for Normal Hair is formulated specifically for this, with a balancing blend of herbs and botanicals. This perfect harmony of mild cleansers and soothing plant extracts will help keep moisture and oils at the right levels for happy and healthy hair. Our unique formula comes from natural beginnings, focusing on herbs and botanical ingredients. Lavender helps to gently cleanse hair, while also lending a relaxing aroma experience. Extracts from sage and rosemary help to nourish the scalp to prevent dryness. It’s the ideal balanced blend for normal hair. Mild by Nature Nature’s Gate Shampoo for Normal Hair pairs with our Conditioner for Normal Hair as a healthy way to care for your hair with clean, natural ingredients. Strike the perfect balance for your hair by using this combo daily.
